reuse.reason: The initialized pinned official webhook packages accept inbound triggers and launch Workspace-backed agent sessions. Their product behavior and Host dependencies do not provide outbound operational notifications; mounting or forking them through a Host-only seam cannot implement Discord/Feishu delivery. This independent Worker plugin uses official webhook protocols, the existing D1 database and a transactionally persisted outbox, without starting agent sessions.
gaps: Delivery acceptance is not an exactly-once guarantee. Ambiguous or interrupted sends require explicit administrator review before retry. No automatic retry queue, cron, arbitrary public relay or real provider delivery verification is supplied.
